# Pesher Psalms Column 5 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Pesher Psalms Column 5 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 5:1-2 — Psalm 37:35-36 — "spreading himself like a green tree" vs. "spreading like a flourishing native tree"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "spreading-himself like a green tree in its native soil" | Literal *mit'areh ke-ezrach ra'anan* |
| LOGOS | "spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil" | Standard rendering |
| PNEUMA | "spreading like a flourishing native tree" | Restructured for flow |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS — "green tree in its native soil" preserves both the Hebrew *ezrach* ("native") and *ra'anan* ("green/luxuriant"). PNEUMA's "flourishing native tree" reverses the modifiers.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 5:3-4 — "elect of God" vs. "elect-ones of God" vs. "God's chosen people"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the elect-ones of God" | Literal with hyphenated plural |
| LOGOS | "the elect of God" | Standard DSS scholarly form |
| PNEUMA | "God's chosen people" | Accessible modern English |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the elect of God" (LOGOS). Clean and scholarly. PNEUMA's "chosen people" could confuse with the broader concept of Israel as God's chosen people.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 5:6 — "Mark the blameless" vs. "Consider the innocent"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Mark the blameless-one" | Literal *shemor tam* |
| LOGOS | "Mark the blameless" | Standard Psalm rendering |
| PNEUMA | "Consider the innocent" | "Innocent" for accessibility |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "Mark the blameless" (LOGOS). *Tam* means "blameless/complete," not "innocent." PNEUMA shifts the semantic range.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 5:6-7 — "a future for the man of peace" vs. "a bright future for the person of peace"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "there is a future for the man of peace" | Literal *acharit le-ish shalom* |
| LOGOS | "there is a future for the man of peace" | Same as EMET |
| PNEUMA | "there is a bright future for the person of peace" | Adds "bright," gender-neutral |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS — "bright" is not in the Hebrew. "Man" preserves the Psalmic *ish*.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 5:13 — "Seekers of Smooth Things" vs. "those who twist the law"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the seekers of smooth-things" | Literal *dorshei ha-chalaqot* |
| LOGOS | "the Seekers of Smooth Things" | Capitalized title, standard |
| PNEUMA | "those who twist the law" | Dynamic — captures the accusation |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the Seekers of Smooth Things" (LOGOS). This is one of the most famous sectarian epithets in DSS scholarship and must be preserved as a recognizable title. PNEUMA's rendering, while capturing the underlying accusation, loses the distinctive terminology.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 5:15 — "congregation of the community" vs. "God's true community"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the congregation of the community" | Literal *adat ha-yahad* |
| LOGOS | "the congregation of the Community" | Capitalizes *yahad* as title |
| PNEUMA | "God's true community" | Dynamic — adds "God's true" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS — "the Community" (*ha-yahad*) is the Qumran community's own name for itself and should be capitalized. PNEUMA's addition of "God's true" is interpretive.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 5:11 — "transgressors" vs. "rebels"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the transgressors shall be destroyed together" | Literal *posh'im* |
| LOGOS | "the transgressors shall be altogether destroyed" | Slight reordering |
| PNEUMA | "rebels will all be destroyed" | "Rebels" for impact |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the transgressors shall be destroyed together" — *posh'im* means "transgressors" (those who violate covenant), not "rebels" (political connotation). "Together" (*yachdav*) is adverbial.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 5:14 — "perish" vs. "be wiped out"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "will perish" | Standard *yovedu* |
| LOGOS | "will perish" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "will be wiped out" | Intensified |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "will perish" (EMET/LOGOS). *Avad* means "perish/be lost," not the intensified "wiped out."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

**Total disagreements for Column 5: 8**
